title: Highly disappointed
body: I was very embarrassed, when I saw on my credit card -28,99€; because I don’t even remember nothing about the subscription. I don’t have it on my apple subscription, I can’t even find where I can cancel it. I wrote email. Hope, they’ll respond me soon. I really don’t recommend it for people with adhd. I bought that book and didn’t even start it.
author: Julia_meow_meow

title: Scam
body: This is a real scam. The subscription is paid for 20 euros per month, it is not possible to unsubscribe anywhere. I also bought a printed book, it was not delivered. The support service offered to refund $5.  I did not receive anything, but 70 euros were debited from the card.
author: lia 3456
